key_structural_result.theorem: packed lagged-store map is strictly upper-triangular in slot index for ANY geometry
key_structural_result.proof: compressing reads use store slot FREQ_IDX_ITER+K2 with K2=NM_RAY>=1 (fg_j_cmf_nonmono_v1.f:4691-4693); writes go to slot FREQ_IDX_ITER (store-update block ~L5887); every packed edge (KC_w,L)<-(KC,L+K2) is strictly upward in slot -> nilpotent
key_structural_result.empirical: swp_w10 map-iteration residual reaches EXACTLY 0 at k=13=NSLOT; nilpotency degree <= NSLOT; power iteration collapses to 0 in first steps
key_structural_result.graph: acyclic by construction; all SCCs singletons; no cross-depth cycles possible in the packed lagged map

fullw05.interpretation: refresh converges internally -> constant map, same as synthetic

swp_w05.note: rho > 1-omega: in-sweep relaxed writes blend old and new at each slot, so the relaxed map is not simply (1-w)I+wF; residual non-nilpotent structure is real but mild

stiffness_attribution.A_large_gam_dln: exercised (SIGT=-155.6, offsets to 12 bins, |GAM|/DLN large): still nilpotent -> does NOT create packed-map stiffness
stiffness_attribution.B_cyclic_donors: impossible in packed map (slot-monotone edges); ruled out
stiffness_attribution.C_block_coupling: expanding reads use I_PREV (unpacked); no packed P<->M or exp<->comp edges; ruled out
stiffness_attribution.D_scattering: real ESEC/CHI_SCAT loaded; map still nilpotent -> scattering does not mediate packed-store coupling (scattering feedback enters JNU/outer loop, not the lagged store)
stiffness_attribution.where_rho_097_lives: in the refresh inner iteration (in-place re-solve, KN_Q_RESID) - NOT in the packed lagged map; the 0.97 pass-ratio is the refresh operator's contraction, a different object

recompute.conclusion: lagged-vs-committed distance (1.4e-8 rel) is 1.65x the refresh truncation (8.6e-9) - same order, genuinely consistent; the 115x was absolute-vs-relative mismatch

limitations: packed map is a fixed-point of the lagged store; the stiff refresh inner operator was not probed here - rho~0.97 lives there
